published.source: Client 70425 racials and the raid damage hits, re-measured on master 4f5c608, 2026-10-16

verify.note: same sim as the published number

summary: Two-hand Fury with a 3.7 sec axe: Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Flurry and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization. Behind both dual wield Fury and Arms.
rotation: Start in Berserker Stance with no Rage; Battle Shout from the raid
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
Death Wish held for the last 36 sec, Recklessness for the last 30 sec
Blood Fury and Berserking held for the last 30 sec, Elune's Light with Death Wish; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20 sec
Execute first in the execute phase
Bloodthirst, then Slam from 30 Rage right after a main hand swing, then Whirlwind at 25+ Rage
Heroic Strike queued from 85 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 30 Strength and 16 crit rating, and an on-use 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, with the last use held for the final 34 s).

White hit Rage is normalized to the weapon: k × swing speed (k is 3.46 one-hand and 4.5 two-hand, measured at level 30). It grows with level to ×1.5 at 60, the same for the off hand. Not yet measured at 60.
Synthetic Phase 1 gear on Forever's physical budget (ids 991001-991018)
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit (client data). Each crit restarting the Deep Wounds tick timer is our modeling choice.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike swings count for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir per character, since it's unknown if Ferocity stacks with Mongoose. A second one (Grizzly) would add 12.0.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece (+36 AP vs Humanoids) not counted. It would add 8.8 (Undead, 180 s).
Holding Death Wish for 36 s is +3.5 at 180 s but -4 at 120 s.
Raid damage hits on the warrior (2 a minute at 1500 damage, about 15 Rage each) are estimated from boss timers. The assumptions panel also runs 0 and 10 a minute.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_fury_2h -talents 30305013032-25053000152110501 -race Orc -duration 180, unedited (mksettings sets the raid hits, 2 a minute at 1500). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts. Uses the Fury class options (Berserker Stance) as the preset build does; the preset's DefaultConsumes keep an off-hand stone, which has no effect without an off hand.
